results.title: الحكومة الرقمية تطلق مؤشر جاهزية تبنّي التقنيات الناشئة لعام 2027
results.description: أطلقت هيئة الحكومة الرقمية اليوم، الدورة الخامسة من مؤشر جاهزية تبنّي التقنيات الناشئة لعام 2027؛ الذي يهدف إلى قياس مستوى جاهزية الجهات الحكومية لتبنّي التقنيات الناشئة، وتحديد الفجوات وفرص التحسين لبناء القدرات وتطوير الخدمات والأداء الحكومي، بما يدعم التوجهات الإستراتيجية للحكومة الرقمية ومستهدفات رؤية السعودية 2030.ويأتي إطلاق الدورة بمشاركة أكثر من 60 جهة حكومية من مختلف القطاعات، في إطار جهود الهيئة لدعم الجهات الحكومية في رحلتها نحو تبنّي التقنيات الناشئة، وتعزيز قدرتها على استكشاف التقنيات المستقبلية وتوظيفها في تطوير الخدمات الحكومية، واتخاذ القرارات المرتبطة بها والاستثمار فيها. ويهدف المؤشر إلى دعم انتقال الجهات الحكومية من مرحلة الجاهزية إلى الريادة التقنية، وتوسيع نطاق توظيف التقنيات الناشئة في الخدمات الحكومية، إلى جانب تحفيز ثقافة الابتكار واستكشاف التقنيات المستقبلية، بما يعزز الاستفادة منها في تحسين الأداء الحكومي، ورفع كفاءة الخدمات الرقمية.وكانت الهيئة قد أصدرت في الربع الأول من العام الجاري تقرير جاهزية تبنّي التقنيات الناشئة لعام 2026، الذي أظهر ارتفاع مستوى الجاهزية لدى الجهات الحكومية، حيث بلغ مستوى الجاهزية 76.04% بمشاركة 54 جهة حكومية.وتصدر هيئة الحكومة الرقمية تقرير المؤشر سنويًّا؛ لتمكين الجهات الحكومية من التعرف على مستويات جاهزيتها، وتحديد الفجوات وفرص التحسين، ودعمها في وضع الأولويات المناسبة لاحتياجاتها الرقمية، بما يُسهم في تعزيز توظيف التقنيات الناشئة، وتحقيق أثر مستدام في الخدمات والأداء الحكومي.
creator: الرياض:-الوطن

results.title: 5 آلاف إجراء بلدي في المشاريع والتخطيط في محافظة البيضاء
results.description: أنجزت أمانة المنطقة الشرقية، ممثلة ببلدية محافظة البيضاء، 5,661 إجراءً في أعمال المشاريع والتخطيط الحضري خلال الربع الثالث من عام 2026، شملت إصدار ودراسة التراخيص والقرارات المساحية، ومتابعة أعمال البناء والإشراف عليها، وتعزيز الرقابة البلدية ومعالجة البلاغات، في إطار جهودها الرامية إلى رفع كفاءة الأداء، وتنظيم أعمال التنمية العمرانية، وتحسين جودة الخدمات المقدمة للمستفيدين، وفق توجيهات وزارة البلديات والإسكان. تطوير منظومة الخدمات البلدية وأوضح مدير عام الإدارة العامة للإعلام والمتحدث الرسمي لأمانة المنطقة الشرقية، فيصل الزهراني، أن هذه المؤشرات تعكس حجم الأعمال والجهود المبذولة في تطوير منظومة الخدمات البلدية، وتعزيز كفاءة الإجراءات المرتبطة بالتخطيط الحضري والمشاريع، بما يسهم في تنظيم أعمال البناء والحفريات، ورفع مستوى الالتزام بالاشتراطات والأنظمة البلدية. وبيّن أن الأعمال المنجزة شملت دراسة وإصدار 793 رخصة حفريات، و847 إجراءً متعلقاً بأعمال الحفر، إلى جانب إعداد 1,862 تقرير إشراف على مراحل البناء، ودراسة وإصدار 278 رخصة بناء، و259 قراراً مساحياً، فضلاً عن دراسة 784 شهادة إشغال وامتثال، بما يعزز كفاءة الإجراءات التنظيمية والفنية المرتبطة بالمشاريع العمرانية. وأضاف فيصل الزهراني، أن الجهود الرقابية تضمنت إصدار 50 مخالفة بناء، ومعالجة 788 بلاغاً، بما يعكس استمرار العمل على تعزيز الرقابة الميدانية، ورصد المخالفات، والتعامل مع البلاغات وفق الإجراءات المعتمدة، بما يحافظ على سلامة البيئة العمرانية ويرفع مستوى الامتثال للاشتراطات البلدية. وأشار المتحدث الرسمي، إلى أن أمانة المنطقة الشرقية تواصل تطوير منظومة العمل البلدي، والارتقاء بكفاءة التخطيط والإشراف والرقابة، وتسهيل الإجراءات والخدمات المقدمة للمستفيدين، بما يدعم استدامة التنمية الحضرية، ويسهم في تحقيق مستهدفات وزارة البلديات والإسكان ورؤية السعودية 2030، وبرنامج جودة الحياة.

results.title: مستشفى الملك عبدالعزيز بمكة ينجح في استئصال ورم بالركبة جراحيًا
results.description: نجح فريق طبي متخصص بمستشفى الملك عبدالعزيز بمكة عضو تجمع مكة المكرمة الصحي في إجراء عملية جراحية دقيقة لاستئصال ورم يقع خلف مفصل الركبة، بمشاركة استشاريي جراحة العظام وجراحة الأوعية الدموية. وكانت المريضة قد راجعت المستشفى وهي تعاني من آلام في منطقة الركبة والساق وبعد إجراء الفحوصات الطبية اللازمة تبيّن وجود ورم خلف مفصل الركبة يتسبب في الضغط على الأوعية الدموية والأعصاب المغذية للساق. تدخل جراحي ناجح وعلى ضوء نتائج التقييم الطبي قرر الفريق المعالج التدخل الجراحي لاستئصال الورم مع الحرص على المحافظة على سلامة الأوعية الدموية والأعصاب المحيطة به. وقد تكللت العملية بالنجاح حيث جرى استئصال الورم دون حدوث مضاعفات أثناء الجراحة. ويأتي هذا النجاح امتدادًا لجهود الكوادر الطبية بمستشفى الملك عبدالعزيز بمكة وحرصها على تقديم خدمات صحية تخصصية وفق أعلى معايير الجودة وسلامة المرضى.

results.title: «مسار الشمال».. حين تتحول الحفاوة السعودية إلى تجربة سياحية تربط الإنسان بالمكان
results.description: ليست المسافات وحدها ما يصنع الرحلات التي تبقى في الذاكرة، بل الأشخاص الذين نلتقي بهم، والحكايات التي نسمعها، والتفاصيل التي تكشف لنا روح المكان. وفي المملكة العربية السعودية، حيث ارتبطت الضيافة بالهوية الاجتماعية وتوارثت الأجيال قيم الكرم والحفاوة، تكتسب السياحة بعداً إنسانياً يتجاوز زيارة المعالم والتقاط الصور، لتصبح فرصة للتعرف على المجتمعات المحلية واكتشاف موروثها الثقافي وعاداتها وتقاليدها. من هذه الرؤية، يبرز «مسار الشمال» بوصفه تجربة سياحية تربط الإنسان بالمكان، وتمنح الزائر فرصة لاكتشاف جانب من الهوية السعودية عبر رحلة تتنوع فيها الوجهات، وتتعدد خلالها الحكايات والتجارب، وتبقى الحفاوة السعودية قاسمًا مشتركًا بين محطاتها. وكان معالي وزير السياحة، رئيس مجلس إدارة الهيئة السعودية للسياحة، الأستاذ أحمد بن عقيل الخطيب، قد أطلق «مسار الشمال» ضمن برنامج شتاء السعودية 2026، تحت شعار «في كل وقفة رحلة»، ليقدم منتجاً سياحيًا يمتد لمسافة 1,200 كيلومتر، انطلاقًا من الرياض وصولًا إلى جبة في منطقة حائل، عبر 16 محطة في مناطق الرياض والقصيم وحائل. ويقدم المسار أكثر من 130 تجربة سياحية متنوعة، تشمل استكشاف القرى التاريخية والمعالم التراثية، والمغامرات الصحراوية، والأنشطة الريفية والثقافية، وتذوق المأكولات المحلية، والتعرف على الحرف التقليدية. الحفاوة السعودية.. موروث يتجدد مع كل زيارة تحتل الضيافة مكانة أصيلة في الثقافة السعودية، إذ لا تقتصر على استقبال الضيف، بل تعكس منظومة من القيم الاجتماعية المتوارثة، تقوم على الكرم والترحيب والاعتزاز بالهوية. ومن خلال «مسار الشمال»، تتحول هذه القيم إلى جزء من التجربة السياحية التي يعيشها الزائر خلال تنقله بين المحافظات والمراكز والقرى التاريخية. ففي كل محطة، تتيح التجارب المحلية فرصة للتعرف على أنماط الحياة التي تشكلت عبر أجيال، من تقاليد استقبال الضيوف إلى المأكولات الشعبية والحرف اليدوية، وصولاً إلى القصص المرتبطة بالبيوت القديمة والأسواق والمزارع والمواقع التراثية. ولا تكمن قيمة هذه التجارب في مشاهدة الموروث فحسب، وإنما في التواصل المباشر مع المجتمعات التي حافظت عليه، والتعرف على معانيه ودلالاته في الحياة اليومية، بما يمنح الزائر فهماً أعمق لخصوصية كل وجهة. ويتيح هذا التواصل تقديم الحفاوة السعودية بوصفها قيمة حية وممارسة اجتماعية مستمرة، وليست مجرد صورة مرتبطة بالماضي، الأمر الذي يعزز حضورها في التجربة السياحية المعاصرة ويسهم في نقلها إلى الزوار من مختلف الثقافات. لكل وجهة حكايتها يمر «مسار الشمال» بمحطات متنوعة تبدأ من الرياض، مروراً بثادق وشقراء وأشيقر والقصب والمجمعة والغاط والزلفي، ثم المذنب وعنيزة والرس والبكيرية وبريدة وعيون الجواء في منطقة القصيم، وصولاً إلى حائل وجبة. وعلى امتداد هذه الرحلة، تتباين البيئات الطبيعية والمعالم العمرانية والموروثات الثقافية، بما يمنح كل محطة شخصية مستقلة. فالقرى التاريخية تقدم شواهد على أنماط العمارة والحياة الاجتماعية، فيما تكشف الأنشطة الريفية عن العلاقة القديمة بين الإنسان والأرض، وتعكس الحرف التقليدية خبرات ومهارات تناقلتها الأجيال. كما تمثل المأكولات المحلية أحد أبرز مداخل التعرف على ثقافة الوجهات، إذ ترتبط الأطباق الشعبية بالمناسبات والعادات وطرق الحياة، وتتيح للزائر اكتشاف جانب من التنوع الثقافي بين مناطق المملكة. وتسهم هذه العناصر مجتمعة في تحويل الرحلة من انتقال جغرافي بين المواقع إلى تجربة ثقافية وإنسانية متصلة، تتشكل من تفاصيل كل محطة وخصوصية أهلها. المجتمعات المحلية في قلب التجربة يعكس «مسار الشمال» أهمية مشاركة المجتمعات المحلية في إثراء المنتجات السياحية، من خلال ما تقدمه من تجارب وخدمات ومعارف مرتبطة بالمكان. وتبرز هذه المشاركة في التعريف بالموروث، وتقديم الأنشطة الثقافية والريفية، وإتاحة الفرصة للزائر للتواصل مع أهل الوجهات التي يمر بها. ويشارك في المسار أكثر من 335 مرشداً سياحياً، إلى جانب 21 شركة لإدارة الوجهات، بما يدعم تقديم التجارب وتنظيمها، ويسهم في التعريف بالمقومات التاريخية والطبيعية والثقافية للمناطق الواقعة على امتداده. ولا تقتصر أهمية هذه المشاركة على إثراء تجربة الزائر، بل تمتد إلى تنشيط الحركة السياحية والاقتصادية في المجتمعات المحلية، وتعزيز حضور المنتجات والخدمات المرتبطة بالموروث والثقافة المحلية. من أصالة الماضي إلى فرص المستقبل يأتي إطلاق «مسار الشمال» في مرحلته الأولية، ضمن توجه لتطويره بصورة مستمرة بالتعاون مع الشركاء، من خلال دراسة إضافة مواقع ومحطات وتجارب جديدة على مدار العام، بما يتيح فرصاً أوسع لإبراز الموروث المحلي وتعزيز مشاركة المجتمعات في النشاط السياحي. ويجسد المسار توجه الهيئة السعودية للسياحة نحو تطوير وتسويق منتجات سياحية تعزز التكامل بين الوجهات، وتدعم السياحة المحلية والوافدة، وتنسجم مع مستهدفات رؤية السعودية 2030. وبين امتداد الطريق وتنوع محطاته، تبقى القيمة الأبرز لـ«مسار الشمال» في الإنسان الذي يمنح المكان روحه، وفي الحفاوة السعودية التي تستقبل الزائر، وفي الموروث الذي يتحول من ذاكرة تتناقلها الأجيال إلى تجربة حية؛ يكتشفها العالم.

results.title: Another Vision of Modernization for the Asia-Pacific
results.description: BEIJING, Nov. 9, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- A news report from China.org.cn on another vision of modernization for the Asia-Pacific. Another Vision of Modernization for the Asia-Pacific Every winter, nearly 100,000 migratory birds fly south from Siberia and land in downtown Shenzhen. Year after year, what kind of city keeps drawing them back? The answer begins at sea. At Nansha Port in Guangzhou stands the world's first fully automated river-sea-rail multimodal terminal, where unmanned vehicles guided by BeiDou satellites operate around the clock. In the cold-chain center next door, the "Cherry Express" and "Durian Express" bring Asia-Pacific's freshest fruit to Chinese tables, while Chinese-made goods set off from the same shore, for the same ocean. Take a look inside the factories. In Shunde, Foshan, the world's largest microwave oven manufacturing base — a World Economic Forum "Lighthouse Factory" — runs a single production line that flexibly switches between multiple models, selling to more than 100 countries and regions. In Dongguan, OPPO has filed over 120,000 patent applications worldwide; while an office chair, designed globally and made locally, now seats people in 127 countries. A complete supply chain and an open business ecosystem give manufacturers here confidence. Now, let's return to where the birds land. The Futian Mangrove Nature Reserve is China's only national nature reserve in the heart of a city. In 2026, the International Mangrove Center began operating right here — the world's first intergovernmental organization dedicated to mangrove conservation. During this year's APEC Ministerial Meeting on Forestry, delegates from 21 economies planted mangrove seedlings to be transplanted into the reserve's "APEC Ministers' Forest." And in nearby Zhongshan, Ming Yang is developing wind power solutions that now reach more than 60 countries. Here, growth and conservation are never mutually exclusive. What holds all this together is the Hong Kong-Zhuhai-Macao Bridge: Spanning 55 kilometers, it is the world's longest sea crossing, handling over 107 million passenger trips by the end of 2025. In 2025, trade through the bridge's ports of entry exceeded 300 billion yuan; with nearly 3 million cross-border e-commerce parcels crossing it every day as of July 2026. The bridge has not only boosted trade, but also brought people closer together. Despite occupying less than 0.6% of China's land, the Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area generates about one-ninth of the national economy —bringing modernization into the lives of millions. In 2026, as APEC comes to Shenzhen, the world will see China and another possibility: that modernization has no single standard answer, and the fast lane of development can still leave room for the flight paths of migratory birds. As cargo ships set sail, production lines hum, and the birds return on schedule, this land is writing a practical, warm-hearted new chapter for the Asia-Pacific. results.title: Sanyou Bio Secures Exclusive Series C Investment from Zero2IPO Industry Investment, Bringing Total Funding to Nearly RMB 300 Million
results.description: Accelerating the Development of an AI-Driven Ecosystem for Innovative Drug R&D and Translation SHANGHAI, Nov. 9, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Sanyou Biopharmaceuticals Co., Ltd. ("Sanyou Bio") recently announced the completion of a Series C financing round worth nearly RMB 100 million. The round was exclusively funded by Zero2IPO Industry Investment, a fund managed by Zero2IPO Group. This financing represents strong recognition from the capital markets of Sanyou Bio's technological capabilities, innovative drug R&D system, and future growth potential. It also marks a new stage in the company's development in innovative drug R&D and commercialization. With the vision of becoming a front-runner in global innovative drug R&D, Sanyou Bio has built a world-leading AI-Super-Trillion Antibody Library (AI-STAL), an integrated wet-lab and dry-lab Sanyou AI-Drug Accelerator (SAI-DA), and Clicklinks, a collaborative innovation platform for original drug discovery and development. Driven by three interconnected pillars—innovation at the source, intelligent acceleration, and pipeline-driven development—the company is systematically addressing bottlenecks in early-stage drug discovery, connecting the entire preclinical R&D value chain, and joining forces with partners to build a new ecosystem for innovative drug development. From technology platform development to innovation ecosystem building, and from enhancing R&D capabilities to advancing drug pipeline translation, Sanyou Bio is exploring new pathways to improve the efficiency of innovative drug R&D and enhance industrial value through a systematic, intelligent, and global development strategy. Previously, Sanyou Bio completed its Series A financing in May 2020, Series B financing in June 2021, and Series B+ financing in August 2022. The completion of this Series C financing marks another significant milestone in the company's development, bringing its total funding raised to nearly RMB 300 million. Synergy Across Three Core Platforms: Building an AI-Driven Innovative Drug R&D System In recent years, the deep integration of artificial intelligence and life sciences has been reshaping the technological pathways and industrial landscape of innovative drug development. Advancing innovative drug R&D requires not only continuous breakthroughs in the efficiency of early-stage molecular discovery, but also the integration of critical links spanning drug design, experimental validation, R&D advancement, and commercialization. In response to these industry needs, Sanyou Bio has progressively established a business model driven by AI technology, supported by intelligent R&D platforms, and guided by its innovative drug pipeline. This financing will further accelerate the development and refinement of this integrated system, supporting the company's evolution from providing innovative drug R&D services toward building pipeline-driven, platform-based, and systematic capabilities for drug innovation and translation. AI-STAL features a proprietary 11-trillion-scale molecular library, providing a powerful foundation for the discovery of novel molecules at the source of innovative drug development. SAI-DA integrates dozens of AI algorithms with wet-lab capabilities covering the entire preclinical R&D process, creating an integrated wet-lab and dry-lab drug development accelerator characterized by automation and intelligence. Clicklinks serves as an open innovation hub for original drug discovery, bringing together global innovation resources and industry partners to foster a collaborative ecosystem for innovative drug R&D. Together, the three platforms form an integrated, end-to-end system spanning early-stage molecular discovery, R&D acceleration, and the translation of innovative discoveries into tangible outcomes. From Platform Development to Pipeline-Driven Growth: Turning Innovative Achievements into Industrial Value Building on its platform capabilities, Sanyou Bio will further focus on pipeline-driven drug development and translation, accelerating the transformation of technological advantages into innovative achievements and industrial value. To date, the company has established partnerships with more than 2,000 pharmaceutical and biotechnology companies worldwide and completed more than 100 collaborative R&D projects, with over 10 innovative drug projects having entered clinical research. In addition, the company has completed 1,000+ drug discovery and stage-specific R&D projects, as well as deliveries of thousands of branded products. Looking ahead, Sanyou Bio will leverage its three core platforms, global partnership network, and accumulated R&D expertise to further strengthen its independent innovation capabilities and pipeline portfolio. Through platform synergy, project-driven development, and open collaboration, the company aims to improve overall efficiency throughout the drug development process, from early-stage research to downstream translation, and enable more innovative discoveries to realize their industrial value. Dr. Guojun Lang, Founder and CEO of Sanyou Bio, commented: "Innovative drug development is a systematic undertaking that requires long-term investment, technological accumulation, and industrial collaboration. Sanyou Bio has always remained committed to its mission of 'To make it easy to develop new drugs worldwide.' Through technological innovation and the development of systematic capabilities, we aim to help the industry improve the efficiency of innovative drug R&D, lower barriers to innovation, and empower more partners in drug development." "This financing represents recognition of our technological achievements and strategic direction to date, while also providing important momentum as we move into our next stage of development. Going forward, we will continue to invest in the development of our three core platforms—AI-STAL, SAI-DA, and Clicklinks—leveraging AI to empower innovative drug R&D, enhancing R&D efficiency through platform synergy, and further focusing on pipeline-driven drug translation. Our goal is to transform our technological strengths into innovative outcomes with genuine clinical and industrial value." "We look forward to working hand in hand with partners around the world to accelerate innovative drug development and bring greater benefits to patients worldwide." Ms. Min Yang, Managing Partner of Zero2IPO Group and Managing Partner of Zero2IPO Industry Investment, commented: "Innovative drug development is a field characterized by high technological barriers, deep professional expertise, and long-term value creation. As artificial intelligence and life sciences continue to converge, the industry is facing increasingly demanding requirements for efficient, intelligent, and systematic drug development capabilities." "Sanyou Bio has established a systematic strategic framework encompassing early-stage molecular discovery, R&D acceleration, and the development of an open innovation ecosystem. We are confident in its long-term potential to leverage AI technology to improve drug development efficiency, expand the boundaries of innovation through platform synergy, and unlock industrial value through the translation of innovative drug pipelines." "Through this investment, we look forward to supporting Sanyou Bio in further deepening its technological innovation and business development, and working together with the company to promote high-quality growth across the innovative drug R&D industry." About Sanyou Bio Sanyou Biopharmaceuticals is a high-tech biopharmaceutical company driven by the mission of "To make it easy to develop new drugs worldwide". Guided by the vision "To become a front-runner in global innovative drug R&D", the company focuses on the R&D and commercialization of innovative drugs. With AI-STAL, our world-leading AI-Super-Trillion Antibody Library, as our source of innovation and SAI-DA, our intelligent Sanyou AI-Drug Accelerator integrating dry-lab (in silico) and wet-lab work, as our core engine, we are building Clicklinks, an open innovation system. Driven by new drug pipelines, we accelerate the translation of innovation to benefit broad patient populations. Headquartered in Shanghai, China, with business centers established across Asia, North America, Europe, and other regions, forming a global business network, Sanyou has more than 20,000 m² of operational and planned R&D and GMP facilities. Sanyou has established strong partnerships with more than 2,000 pharmaceutical and biotechnology companies worldwide. We have signed 100+ collaborative R&D agreements. The company has filed more than 180 invention patent applications, with more than 30 granted. About Zero2IPO Industry Investment Zero2IPO Industry Investment is a core business platform under Zero2IPO Group dedicated to industrial investment. results.title: Consello Strengthens Ireland Team with Managing Director Appointments
results.description: NEW YORK, Nov. 9, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Consello, the leading global advisory and investing platform, today announced the appointment of Niamh Garvey and Peter Davis as Managing Directors in its Dublin office to strengthen the firm's CEO advisory capabilities in Ireland. Garvey and Davis bring expertise in strategic communications, public policy, transactions, and capital markets to the firm. Garvey has spent more than 25 years advising CEOs and boards, both internationally and locally, through complex reputational, regulatory and policy issues. She has held senior leadership roles in London and Dublin and led global mandates on issues central to long-term growth and enterprise value, with deep expertise in healthcare. Davis has nearly two decades of experience in public company advisory, mergers and acquisitions, and equity capital markets. He has held corporate finance and investment banking roles at KPMG, Citi and Deutsche Bank, supporting global equity capital markets and M&A. Consello Founder, Chairman and CEO Declan Kelly said, "Niamh and Peter bring exceptional, complementary skill sets that further strengthen Consello's ability to support clients in Ireland and across our global platform. As our presence and client needs continue to grow, these leaders will help us even better support the leaders on the ground navigating complex regulatory and capital-markets decisions." About Consello Consello is an Advisory and Investing Platform with offices in New York, Miami, Atlanta, Dublin, Belfast, London, Brussels, and Abu Dhabi. Consello's distinct advisory practices provide the complete strategic counsel today's leaders need to grow and transform their organizations. Consello's advisory expertise spans Corporate Advisory; M&A; Management Consulting; Talent; Sports and Entertainment; Strategic Communications; Geopolitics; and Risk. Dedicated teams operate in each practice, led by a leadership group with deep operational experience across industries, business growth stages and market cycles and with an expansive set of global corporate relationships. Consello's investment business, Consello Capital, identifies high-potential mid-market companies and invests capital and expertise to transform their growth. results.title: Apptio Expands Portfolio to Help Enterprises Connect AI Spending to Business Value
results.description: Updates include new connections for leading frontier AI systems, expanded financial planning and AI-assisted analysis Key facts Track AI spending alongside broader technology costs, with direct connections that bring model consumption and usage data into the Apptio portfolio. Plan and optimize AI spending with IBM Cloudability capabilities for AI application costing, token usage, budgeting, forecasting and AI service commitment recommendations. Connect AI investments and AI TCO to business results with new IBM Apptio AI Value & ROI capabilities. ARMONK, N.Y., Nov. 9, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Apptio, an IBM company (NYSE: IBM), today is announcing new connections for leading frontier AI systems to help enterprises track AI costs and usage alongside their broader technology spending. The connections accompany expanded AI cost-management capabilities across its portfolio to help organizations forecast spending, evaluate costs against business results and decide which AI investments to scale. An IBM IBV study published in June 2026 found that 85% of surveyed technology executives reported that they lack full visibility into real-time AI spending. With costs spread across model providers, cloud infrastructure, applications and teams, organizations need a clearer picture of what AI initiatives cost and which are delivering business value. Beyond the new AI connection capabilities, IBM is expanding capabilities across the Apptio portfolio to help organizations plan AI spending, measure business value and understand Kubernetes network costs. New Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers and AI-assisted analysis also help teams access and analyze technology financial data through AI tools of their choice. "AI investment is growing faster than many organizations can effectively govern and evaluate, and fragmented and outdated technology and AI data only adds to the complexity," said Eugene Khvostov, Chief Product Officer, IBM Apptio. "We're expanding these capabilities across our portfolio to address these challenges head-on and give teams the technology financial intelligence they need to understand the economics of AI at the most granular and real-time level, make better decisions and direct investment toward the initiatives delivering the greatest value." Connecting AI usage with enterprise technology economics IBM is introducing direct native AI cost and usage connections for leading frontier AI systems across the Apptio portfolio. These connections are designed to help organizations incorporate AI consumption data into their broader technology financial management practices, providing greater visibility into an increasingly important category of enterprise technology spend. IBM is also introducing MCP servers designed to connect financial, operational, organizational and portfolio data with external AI tools, helping organizations to bring technology into the environments where their teams work and make decisions. Bringing AI-powered insights across the Apptio portfolio IBM is expanding AI-assisted decision support across the product portfolio. Users can ask natural-language questions of their financial, cloud and portfolio data to surface drivers, risks and opportunities and reach insights quickly, helping to reduce reliance on specialist users or manual navigation through reports. New and enhanced capabilities include: More comprehensive AI cost management and AI Insights in IBM Cloudability. Alongside traditional cloud costs, organizations can incorporate AI application costing as well as usage and token data. Cloudability also supports AI and cloud unit economics and optimization of AI rates through commitment recommendations for hyperscalers' AI services, while financial planning capabilities can support forecasting and budgeting for AI costs. AI Assistant enables users to ask plain-English questions about cloud and AI spend and receive insights generated from their connected data. Expanded AI capabilities in IBM Apptio. Features including, IBM Apptio AI Assistant, AI Lens and AI Data Assistant are designed to accelerate analysis and automate data preparation, while expanded AI Economics capabilities provide deeper visibility into AI spend, total cost and usage. New AI Value & ROI capabilities are designed to help organizations connect technology investments with measurable business outcomes, while driver-based planning is designed to improve forecasting of variable spend. Enhanced Kubernetes network cost visibility in IBM Kubecost. Expanded network cost visibility helps teams understand the network costs generated by their Kubernetes environments, with added detail for AWS NAT Gateway ingress and egress, cross-zone and cross-region traffic. Organizations can more easily investigate what is driving network spend and connect those charges back to the Kubernetes resources and traffic patterns behind them. "Enterprises are investing aggressively in AI, but visibility into cost alone isn't enough. Leaders need to understand what they're spending, who owns it and, ultimately, what value the business is getting in return," said Tim Crawford, Founder and Principal Analyst, AVOA. "By bringing together technology, financial and portfolio intelligence, Apptio is helping organizations create a more complete picture of their AI and broader technology investments to make better decisions." Together, these capabilities are designed to give technology, finance and business leaders a more connected approach to managing the economics of AI, from understanding underlying consumption and infrastructure costs to planning investments and measuring the business value they generate, helping organizations make smarter, faster and more informed technology investment decisions. Availability: AI system connectors are generally available, with connectors for additional sources planned for Q4. MCP servers for IBM Cloudability (GA: Q4), IBM Apptio (GA: Q4), IBM Kubecost (GA: Q3) and IBM Targetprocess (GA: Q4) IBM Cloudability support for AI Commitments available in Q3, with continued incremental support in Q1 and Q2 2027 IBM Cloudability support for AI Unit Economics is generally available, with additional enhancements in Q4 2026 and incremental support in Q1 and Q2 2027. IBM Cloudability Financial Planning for AI services is generally available. IBM Apptio AI Assistant (Conversational Insights & Expert Guidance), AI Lens (Report Summarization) and AI Data Assistant are generally available. IBM Apptio AI Value & ROI and AI Economics maturity journey via AI Spend, AI TCO & Usage enhancements are generally available as of November 6, 2026. Driver-Based Planning will be generally available in Q4. AI Scenario Planning will be available in Q4. IBM Kubecost expanded network cost visibility is generally available to all product tiers. About Apptio, an IBM Company Apptio, an IBM company, is a leading technology spend and value management software provider. Apptio's AI-powered data insights empower leaders to make smarter financial and operational decisions across Information Technology (IT), multi-cloud FinOps and digital product development. Apptio's mission is to deliver business value with every technology investment and team. Powered by Apptio's cloud platform, Apptio's SaaS applications help translate technology spend into clear business outcomes and financial ROI. As a pioneer and category leader in Technology Business Management (TBM), FinOps and Agile Portfolio Management, Apptio works with thousands of customers, partners and community members worldwide. ¹ IBM Institute for Business Value, June 2026. Survey of 2,000 senior technology executives across 33 geographies and 19 industries, conducted with Oxford Economics from January to April 2026. Statements regarding IBM's future direction and intent, including anticipated availability dates and functionality, are subject to change or withdrawal without notice and represent goals and objectives only. results.title: LPGA Tour Veteran Ryann O'Toole Wins 2026 Aon Risk Reward Challenge and $1 Million Prize
results.description: After 15 years on the LPGA Tour, O'Toole earns a career-defining achievement through strategic decision-making, capping a standout season as she prepares to welcome her first child NAPLES, Fla., Nov. 9, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Aon plc (NYSE: AON), a leading global professional services firm, and the LPGA Tour today announced Ryann O'Toole as the winner of the 2026 Aon Risk Reward Challenge, earning the Aon trophy and $1 million prize. O'Toole's victory was built on a season of consistently making the right decisions when risk and opportunity were at its highest. Analysis of her performance on the Aon Risk Reward Challenge holes shows how she converted those moments into competitive advantage, finishing 22-under-par across her counting scores and delivering some of her best golf of the season when it mattered most. Across 12 Challenge holes, with her two best scores counting on each, O'Toole finished 21-under-par on the par 5s, including four eagles. She hit 21 of 24 greens in regulation, or 87.5%, 22 percentage points higher than her overall season average and recorded 15 one-putts without a single three-putt. Her performance on the Challenge holes reflected a broader transformation in her game. After ranking 125th on the LPGA Tour in par-5 scoring in 2025, O'Toole climbed to 11th in 2026, the best ranking of her 16-year career. At age 39, she also averaged a career-best 270.6 yards off the tee, combining improved distance with consistent execution to capitalize on opportunity throughout the season. For O'Toole, those decisions extended beyond the golf course. Having built a commanding lead in the Challenge standings and secured the minimum number of rounds required to qualify, she made the decision to conclude her 2026 LPGA Tour season following the FM Championship as she prepared for the birth of her first child. It meant leaving the final outcome of the Challenge in the hands of the remaining field, confident in the position she had created through her performance across the season. "Ryann is a veteran who knows exactly when to take a risk and how to deliver on it, and watching her win the 2026 Aon Risk Reward Challenge has been inspiring," said Craig Kessler, LPGA Commissioner. "A year after going back to Q-Series to earn her card, Ryann finished on top while playing a limited schedule, all while navigating her pregnancy and supporting her brother in his recovery from a severe accident. That's really special golf." "Aon's philosophy of making better decisions in the face of uncertainty resonates with me more than ever this year," said O'Toole. "Sometimes the greatest rewards come from continuing to trust yourself, staying committed to what matters most, and embracing the opportunities in front of you, even when the path doesn't look exactly how you imagined." A 15-year veteran of the LPGA Tour, O'Toole has built a career defined by dedication, perseverance and longevity. Her 2026 Aon Risk Reward Challenge victory represents one of the most significant achievements of her professional career, with the $1 million prize nearly doubling her highest single-season on-course earnings. "Ryann's performance shows what better decision making looks like: understanding the risk, recognizing the opportunity and having the confidence to act when it matters most," said Anne Corona, CEO of North America, Aon. "We are proud to celebrate her as the newest Aon Risk Reward Challenge champion, and we wish Ryann and her partner, Gina, all the best as they prepare to welcome their first child." O'Toole adds the Aon Risk Reward Challenge title to her list of career accomplishments, joining past champions Carlota Ciganda, Hannah Green, Minjee Lee, Angel Yin and Jeeno Thitikul and Jennifer Kupcho. "For Ryann and Gina, as they get ready to welcome their son, I know this $1 million prize means a lot," said Kessler. We're so grateful to Aon for rewarding smart, brave golf and helping shine a light on stories like Ryann's. Congratulations, Ryann - we can't wait to see you back out here with your newest fan cheering you on." For more information on Aon's sports partnerships across the PGA Tour, LPGA Tour, Scuderia Ferrari and Ferrari Hypersail, see here. About the Aon Risk Reward Challenge In the seventh season, the Aon Risk Reward Challenge brings better decision-making to life though elite performance. The Challenge tabulates the two best scores from every participating event a player competes in with players required to compete in a minimum of 40 rounds throughout the season to qualify. Players must weigh risk and opportunity, while data and analysis provides insight into the decisions they make and how those decisions translate into performance. The Challenge runs across 28 regular season tournaments with the Golf Channel as its official broadcast partner. Each week in broadcast, Aon provides insights specific to the Aon Risk Reward Challenge hole. To view the final Aon Risk Reward Challenge leaderboard on the LPGA Tour and for more information, click here. About Aon Aon plc (NYSE: AON) exists to shape decisions for the better — to protect and enrich the lives of people around the world. Through actionable analytic insight, globally integrated Risk Capital and Human Capital expertise, and locally relevant solutions, our colleagues provide clients in over 120 countries with the clarity and confidence to make better risk and people decisions that protect and grow their businesses. Follow Aon on LinkedIn, X, Facebook and Instagram. Stay up-to-date by visiting Aon's newsroom and sign up for news alerts here. About the LPGA The Ladies Professional Golf Association (LPGA) is the world's premier women's professional golf organization. Created in 1950 by 13 pioneering female Founders, the LPGA, whose Members now represent nearly 40 countries, is the longest-standing professional women's sports organization. Through the LPGA Tour, the Epson Tour, the LPGA Professionals, and a joint venture with the Ladies European Tour, the LPGA provides female professionals the opportunity to pursue their dreams in the game of golf at the highest level. In addition to its professional tours and teaching accreditation programs, the LPGA features a fully integrated Foundation, which provides best-in-class programming for female golfers through its junior golf programming, and its LPGA Amateurs division, which offers its members playing and learning opportunities around the world. The LPGA aims to use its unique platform to inspire, transform and advance opportunities for girls and women, on and off the golf course. Follow the LPGA online at www.LPGA.com and download its mobile apps on Apple or Google Play. Join the social conversation on Facebook, X (formerly known as Twitter), Instagram and YouTube. About the LPGA Tour The LPGA Tour is the world's leading competitive destination for the best female professional golfers in the world. The Tour hosts 33 annual events across 13 countries for over 200 athletes, awarding total prize funds exceeding $132 million and reaching television audiences in more than 170 countries.
